definitions.gloss: rapid approach; quick closing of distance
definitions.explanation: A physical object or person approaching rapidly. Used for vehicles, aircraft, or other objects moving quickly toward something.

definitions.gloss: suddenly becoming close; rapid development of a relationship
definitions.explanation: A sudden deepening of a personal or diplomatic relationship. Often used in gossip media for romantic relationships or in news for political relations between countries.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{急接近|きゅうせっきん}している。
{後|うし}ろから{車|くるま}が{急接近|きゅうせっきん}してきた。
examples.english: A car rapidly approached from behind.

examples.japanese: {敵|てき}の{戦闘機|せんとうき}がレーダーに{映|うつ}り、こちらに{急接近|きゅうせっきん}していることが{判明|はんめい}した。
examples.english: An enemy fighter appeared on radar and was found to be rapidly approaching our position.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{急接近|きゅうせっきん}した。
{共演|きょうえん}をきっかけに{急接近|きゅうせっきん}したと{報|ほう}じられた。
examples.english: It was reported that they suddenly became close after co-starring together.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{経済|けいざい}{協力|きょうりょく}を{通|つう}じて{急接近|きゅうせっきん}し、{新|あら}たな{同盟|どうめい}{関係|かんけい}を{築|きず}いた。
examples.english: The two countries rapidly drew closer through economic cooperation and built a new alliance.

notes:
Composed of {急|きゅう} (sudden, rapid) and {接近|せっきん} (approach, proximity).

Sense 2 is very common in tabloid headlines and entertainment news, especially for celebrity romantic relationships.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台風|たいふう}が{急接近|きゅうせっきん}する (a typhoon rapidly approaches)
- {二人|ふたり}が{急接近|きゅうせっきん}する (two people suddenly become close)
- {両国|りょうこく}が{急接近|きゅうせっきん}する (two countries rapidly draw closer)
